settings.open.label: Open Settings
settings.open.description: Open or focus the application settings window.

window.toggleMaximize.label: Maximize or Restore Window
window.toggleMaximize.description: Toggle the primary workspace between maximized and windowed.

window.toggleFullscreen.label: Toggle Fullscreen
window.toggleFullscreen.description: Enter or leave native fullscreen presentation.

content.hardReload.label: Hard Reload Workspace
content.hardReload.description: Reload the remote workspace while ignoring cache.

content.zoomReset.label: Reset Content Zoom
content.zoomReset.description: Reset the workspace content zoom to 100 percent.

devtools.open.label: Open Content DevTools
devtools.open.description: Open developer tools for the workspace content.

window.toggleDrag.label: Toggle Window Drag Mode
window.toggleDrag.description: Turn whole-window dragging and free resizing on or off.
